A filling dish made by grilling various mountain ingredients with either steak or bird meat.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Meat and Mushroom Skewer}}
A filling dish made by grilling various mountain ingredients with meat.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Meat and Mushroom Skewers are [[Meal]]s made by [[Cooking]] any piece of [[Meat]] with [[Mushroom]]s in a [[Cooking Pot]]. The regular version can be made either by using [[Hylian Shroom]]s, which offer no status effects, or by using multiple Mushrooms with different effects. When consumed, they will heal several of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. Several different variations of Meat and Mushroom Skewers can be made by using different [[Ingredient]]s: * '''Chilly Meat and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Meat and Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
A filling dish made by grilling various mountain ingredients with either steak or bird meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Chillshroom]]s. They grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Electro Meat and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Meat and Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
A filling dish made by grilling various mountain ingredients with either steak or bird meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Zapshroom]]s. Consuming these skewers will grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Meat and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Meat and Mushroom Skewer}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
A filling dish made by grilling various mountain ingredients with either steak or bird meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Endura Shroom]]s. When eaten, they completely refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Meat and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Meat and Mushroom Skewer}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A filling dish made by grilling various mountain ingredients with either steak or bird meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Stamella Shroom]]s. They can be eaten to restore a portion of Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Meat and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Meat and Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A filling dish made by grilling various mountain ingredients with either steak or bird meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Rushroom]]s. If eaten, they will temporarily boost Link's movement speed. * '''Hearty Meat and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Meat and Mushroom Skewer}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A filling dish made by grilling various mountain ingredients with either steak or bird meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Truffle]]s or [[Big Hearty Truffle]]s. Eating these skewers will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Mighty Meat and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Meat and Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
A filling dish made by grilling various mountain ingredients with either steak or bird meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Razorshroom]]s. Eating them temporarily increases the power of Link's attacks. * '''Sneaky Meat and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Meat and Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
A filling dish made by grilling various mountain ingredients with either steak or bird meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Silent Shroom]]s. If eaten, they increase Link's [[Stealth]] for a short period of time. * '''Spicy Meat and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Meat and Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A filling dish made by grilling various mountain ingredients with either steak or bird meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Sunshroom]]s. They grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Tough Meat and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Meat and Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
A filling dish made by grilling various mountain ingredients with either steak or bird meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Ironshroom]]s. Link's [[Defense]] will be increased by eating these skewers. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Fish and Mushroom Skewer * Food * Meat Skewer * Mushroom Skewer }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Skewers |items= BotW, TotK }}
